title: [LOGGED OUT] http and non-www addresses go to https www with a permanent redirect
reason: http redirect is a temporary 302 (not 301/308), and https://demoblaze.com/ stays on non-www (no redirect to www)

steps.text: Open http://www.demoblaze.com/ and wait until loaded.
Read the redirect status of http://www.demoblaze.com/.

steps.text: Is it a permanent redirect (301 or 308), not a temporary 302?

Is the address now https://www.demoblaze.com/ (redirected to www)?
